method.claim_boundary: Audit findings identify code/research risks. They are not performance results, fault-rate estimates, or flight qualification.

issues.title: 38-case confirmatory inference records group_id but ordinary exact McNemar ignores clustering
evidence: src/astrograph/evaluation/llm_method_campaign.py: freeze_confirmatory_case_manifest() assigns group_id
src/astrograph/evaluation/llm_method_campaign.py: paired_arm_effect() indexes only case_id and calls exact_mcnemar_two_sided()
configs/evaluation/llm_method_acceptance.v2.json: EXACT_TWO_SIDED_MCNEMAR
issues.impact: Cases sharing a trajectory/subsystem group can be statistically dependent. Treating all 38 paired case outcomes as independent can misstate sampling variability and p-values.
issues.gate: Resolve and preregister before any A0-A7 result is used for promotion.
issues.recommendation: Make the inferential unit group-aware. Freeze a clustered matched-pair method (for example cluster-level permutation/sign approach, cluster-adjusted McNemar, or a justified hierarchical model), report number of independent groups, and retain case-level descriptive counts.

issues.title: Probe-promotion question and current primary confirmatory estimand are not the same comparison
evidence: configs/evaluation/llm_method_acceptance.v2.json: primary A2_CONTROLLED_FULL vs A0_ALGORITHM_ONLY
same config: A2 vs A7_NO_ACTIVE_PROBE is secondary/descriptive unless separately preregistered
roadmap/ledger ties future Probe promotion to confirmatory evidence
issues.impact: A2-vs-A0 estimates the effect of the whole controlled-LLM stack, not the marginal contribution of active Probe. A positive full-stack result cannot by itself identify Probe benefit.
issues.gate: Before formal EvidenceFact-producer review for Probe.
issues.recommendation: Preregister A2-vs-A7 as the Probe-specific primary or co-primary estimand, with its own induced-error, effect-size/CI, multiplicity and minimum-benefit rules.

issues.title: Promotion gate lacks a preregistered effect-size confidence interval and power/minimum-detectable-effect justification
evidence: configs/evaluation/llm_method_acceptance.v2.json thresholds
paired_arm_effect() returns counts and exact p-value but no compatible CI
issues.impact: Significance alone does not establish a practically meaningful gain. With induced errors fixed at zero, the exact two-sided test also makes min_net_gain=1 largely non-binding once p<=0.05 is satisfied.
issues.gate: Before formal confirmatory execution if results may support promotion.
issues.recommendation: Freeze an effect estimand (paired difference or group-level effect), confidence interval, minimum meaningful effect and power/precision rationale. Treat p-value as one component rather than the promotion effect measure.

issues.title: Non-finite/quality-flagged FeatureResult can be compiled as ordinary NOT_SATISFIED instead of invalid/missing data
evidence: src/astrograph/evidence/executable.py: FeatureResult permits float NaN and carries quality_flags
evaluate_evidence() only treats None as MISSING_DATA before numeric comparison
reaction_wheel_executable.py can emit NONFINITE_INPUT quality flags
R14 deterministic probe reproduced NaN + NONFINITE_INPUT -> NOT_SATISFIED
issues.impact: Data-quality failure can be interpreted as negative evidence rather than unavailable evidence. This is upstream of deterministic hypothesis compilation and therefore matters more than an LLM-only presentation defect.
issues.gate: Fix before treating the unified tree as a candidate for any formal-evidence qualification.
issues.recommendation: Define a central FeatureResult validity taxonomy. Reject non-finite values at the model boundary (or map them to INVALID_DATA/MISSING_DATA), make severe quality flags fail closed before threshold comparison, and apply the same policy to conjunctive feature results.

issues.title: Mixed evidence + knowledge citations bypass Agent paragraph numeric grounding
evidence: src/astrograph/integrations/platform_agent.py: numeric grounding is called only when paragraph_citations <= evidence_ids
R14 deterministic probe: E1=0.2 A + K1 visible, text=900 A, citations=[E1,K1] -> accepted
issues.impact: R13 fixed single-evidence citation value substitution, but a mixed-source paragraph can still reuse a valid evidence ID while adding an unsupported explicit measurement.
issues.gate: Fix before describing Agent narrative numeric grounding as complete.
issues.recommendation: Run measurement grounding on the evidence-citation subset even when knowledge citations are also present; require each explicit measured claim to bind a supporting EvidenceFact/span rather than letting a mixed citation set disable the check.

issues.title: Confirmatory execution receipt freezes model ID but not full model/runtime/software identity
evidence: build_confirmatory_execution_receipt() v3 freezes design/case/dataset snapshot, vLLM URL/model ID, Python/platform, arm order and thresholds
post-execution identity rechecks advertised model ID but not model artifact bytes/revision
issues.impact: An identical served model ID can point to different weights/tokenizer/runtime builds. Source/dependency/accelerator drift can also change inference while current identity remains STABLE.
issues.gate: Close before claiming a reproducible real A0-A7 campaign.
issues.recommendation: Freeze model artifact/revision and tokenizer hashes, vLLM/container/build identity, AstroGraph SOURCE_MANIFEST hash, dependency lock/SBOM, CUDA/driver/GPU identity, and the complete inference config/prompt-profile hash.

issues.title: No real confirmatory, HIL, target-hardware or operational-shadow validation yet
evidence: R13/R12 implementation ledger explicitly states no real ADCS/PHM + live-vLLM 38x8 result
current PUBLIC_CASE and maintenance children remain non-release-eligible
issues.impact: Software correctness and simulator regression do not establish spacecraft diagnostic validity, robustness or flight suitability.
issues.gate: Required before any stronger-than-engineering qualification claim.
issues.recommendation: Adopt a validation ladder: frozen simulation -> cross-simulator/domain-shift -> hardware/processor-in-loop fault injection -> target compute/resource/stress -> operational shadow telemetry -> independent release review.

issues.title: Hand-engineered RW softmax scores are typed as PROBABILITIES despite explicit uncalibrated status
evidence: src/astrograph/integrations/sat_sim_pipeline.py: hand-built raw_scores -> _softmax()
same file declares ModelOutputSemantics.PROBABILITIES
formal binding/calibration boundaries are otherwise explicit
issues.impact: Normalization to one does not make an engineering score a probabilistic estimate. The type encourages downstream/user misinterpretation even though BiRRF currently relies mainly on ranking and guards calibration claims.
issues.gate: Before publishing probability-like performance or using magnitude as calibrated confidence.
issues.recommendation: Represent these as NONNEGATIVE_SCORES or add a dedicated normalized-heuristic semantics. Reserve PROBABILITIES for a model with calibration evidence and an explicit calibration receipt.

issues.title: R13 analysis/display separation fixes key bugs, but temporal/statistical thresholds remain heuristic and sampling-sensitive at scale
evidence: temporal_localization.py uses fixed causal baseline horizon and fixed z/window/confirmation choices
maintenance analysis caps/selection still bound channels/rows for UI-side analytics
multidimensional diagnostics use engineering z/threshold rules
issues.impact: Append invariance and peak preservation are improved, but false-alarm rate, delay, cadence sensitivity, early-fault contamination and >20k sampling effects are not yet calibrated as diagnostic performance.
issues.gate: Optimization before research claims based on these maintenance statistics; not currently a formal Evidence vote.
issues.recommendation: Add explicit time-axis admission, streaming/full-series statistics, early-anomaly-safe baseline policy, nominal false-alarm/ARL calibration, delay distributions, and sensitivity analysis for cadence/window/threshold choices.

issues.title: Supplemental capsule verifies shape/window/unit but not a full acquisition/sampling pedigree
evidence: maintenance_input_admission.py permits non-decreasing timestamps (duplicates allowed)
requires at least one finite admitted sample but no operator-specific minimum cadence/coverage/gap rule
source_note is descriptive rather than a signed acquisition identity
issues.impact: This is acceptably bounded today because overlays are non-release-eligible, but it is insufficient provenance for any future path toward formal telemetry/evidence.
issues.gate: Before supplemental inputs are ever considered for formal release evidence.
issues.recommendation: Bind acquisition source, sensor/calibration version, timestamp uniqueness/cadence/gap rules, minimum coverage/sample count by operator, uncertainty/precision and authenticated provenance.

issues.title: Open-set/abstention mechanisms have strong scope labels but limited external validity
evidence: diagnosis/sat_sim_open_set.py states limited Basilisk laboratory calibration and not flight reliability
data_driven/adcs_posthoc.py v2 uses group-isolated calibration/qualification and explicitly bounds OOD threat model
issues.impact: OOD/rejection behavior can change materially under simulator, spacecraft, sensor, mission-phase and covariate/conditional shifts not represented by the calibration set.
issues.gate: Before using abstention thresholds as operational reliability claims.
issues.recommendation: Evaluate risk-coverage and OOD detection with confidence intervals across independent simulator/HIL/corruption/mission-condition sets. Consider conformal/risk-control methods only where their assumptions and target risk are explicitly satisfied.

issues.title: BiRRF governance is stronger than its empirical weight/smoothing calibration
evidence: fusion/birrf.py handles branch weights, reciprocal rank smoothing, KG redundancy correlation, shared correlation groups and KG fault-universe coverage
production-strict policy is explicitly not a calibrated-probability claim
issues.impact: Rank fusion is robust to uncalibrated score magnitudes but can remain sensitive to source ordering, weight/smoothing choices, source dependence and KG quality. Coverage of a fault universe does not prove causal correctness of KG edges.
issues.gate: Before claiming fusion weights are empirically optimal or calibrated.
issues.recommendation: Run preregistered weight/smoothing sensitivity, leave-one-source-out and dependence perturbation studies; independently validate KG edge quality/source independence and compare against simpler fusion baselines.

issues.title: Formal confirmatory scope is effectively single-fault/class-mapped; compound/cascade faults are not established
evidence: 38-case design selects exact registered fault-class mapping from ADCS/PHM test rows
large parts of candidate/fault classification contracts are single-label/multiclass
issues.impact: A spacecraft fault-management claim broader than isolated registered faults would exceed the evaluated fault model.
issues.gate: Before generalizing to multi-fault/cascading diagnosis.
issues.recommendation: State single-fault scope explicitly, then create separate compound/cascade/unknown-fault campaigns with interaction-aware truth and partial-credit/isolation metrics.

issues.title: Confirmatory metrics emphasize classification but under-specify operational fault-management costs
evidence: required metrics include accuracy/macro-F1/balanced accuracy/coverage/selective risk and diagnostic gain
formal campaign does not preregister mission-time false alarm rate, detection/isolation delay or availability/action cost
issues.impact: Two systems with similar classification accuracy can have very different operational utility and safety due to false-alarm burden and detection latency.
issues.gate: Before claiming operational FDIR/PHM effectiveness.
issues.recommendation: Add event/window-level false alarms per operating time, missed-event rate, detection/isolation delay distributions, abstention duration, resource/latency budget and downstream action/recovery correctness where applicable.

issues.title: 38-case denominator yields very sparse per-class evidence and highly discrete macro metrics
evidence: case design fixes sample_index in {4,9}, expected 28 ADCS + 10 PHM cases
each exact mapped class therefore has very few independent realizations
issues.impact: Macro-F1/balanced accuracy and class-specific conclusions can have large uncertainty. More cases from the same trajectory group do not create equivalent independent information.
issues.gate: Before class-specific efficacy claims.
issues.recommendation: Report per-class/group denominators and intervals, expand independent trajectory/fault-severity/mission-condition groups, and base sample-size planning on independent groups rather than raw case count.

issues.title: Unified metadata closes an existing joblib gap but minimal-headless dependency boundaries can be cleaner
evidence: R13 Backend pyproject omitted joblib while shared integrations eager-imported a joblib-using scientific-model module
complete Platform pyproject declares joblib; R14 canonical tree retains it
issues.impact: Current merged project is internally consistent, but a truly minimal core install still imports some scientific integration surface eagerly.
issues.gate: Optimization only; do not reintroduce dual source trees.
issues.recommendation: If minimal deployment matters, make scientific-model integrations lazy and move joblib/ML stack behind an explicit extra while adding import-with-core-only contract tests.

issues.title: Several governance/control-plane modules are very large and broad exception handling is frequent
evidence: upload_report.py ~3121 LOC; cli.py ~2357; api.py ~1526; whole_spacecraft_stage_executor.py ~1453; llm_method_campaign.py ~1313
static scan: 194 occurrences of `except Exception` across 92 source files; upload_report.py contains 27
issues.impact: Large change surfaces and generic exception translation raise review, fault-isolation and error-taxonomy risk even when tests pass.
issues.gate: Maintainability/audit optimization, especially before safety-critical qualification work.
issues.recommendation: Split admission/state/materialization/presentation/orchestration responsibilities, replace broad catches at trust boundaries with typed reason codes, and add contract tests per boundary.

issues.title: Evidence EQUAL/NOT_EQUAL operators use exact floating-point equality
evidence: evidence/executable.py compare_value(): `value == threshold` / `value != threshold`
current frozen evidence configs do not appear to rely on continuous-valued equality comparisons
issues.impact: Latent risk if future continuous telemetry evidence uses equality; exact binary float comparison rarely expresses engineering tolerance.
issues.gate: Before introducing a continuous EQUAL/NOT_EQUAL EvidenceDefinition.
issues.recommendation: Reserve exact equality for discrete/coded semantics or add an explicitly versioned tolerance/quantization contract.

issues.title: Manual R13 response bundles prove integrity/identity, not producer authenticity or raw-recompute provenance
evidence: Manual provider hashes schema/request/project/run identities and safe-ZIP limits
receipt explicitly records raw_telemetry_recompute_verified=false and formal_release_eligible=false
issues.impact: This is correct for manual exchange. Future remote automatic providers would need stronger origin and execution trust if their output were ever elevated.
issues.gate: Before remote provider results can contribute to any formal evidence/release path.
issues.recommendation: Add provider authentication/signatures, nonce/replay protection, software/container/model identity, raw-input provenance/attestation and policy-scoped authorization. Keep hash integrity distinct from origin trust.

issues.title: KG fault-universe coverage is a completeness control, not a validity/causality measurement
evidence: production-strict requires KG fault-universe coverage and suppresses incomplete branches
BiRRF records KG coverage/declaration lineage and correlation/redundancy
issues.impact: A graph can cover every registered fault yet contain weak, dependent or incorrect causal/evidence relations.
issues.gate: Before claiming KG coverage implies diagnostic knowledge quality.
issues.recommendation: Define edge-level provenance/review grade, causal-vs-associational semantics, independent-source count, contradiction/age handling, and measure incremental diagnostic utility with blinded leave-edge/source-out evaluations.

issues.title: Numeric grounding is deterministic but unit/claim semantics remain narrow
evidence: platform_knowledge.py checks explicit number+unit pairs with exact normalized unit and near-exact numeric value
summary validation is against the allowed evidence set rather than a fine-grained claim-to-span mapping
issues.impact: Equivalent unit conversions, derived quantities, rounding policy and qualitative entailment are not represented; citation presence alone is not full support.
issues.gate: Optimization before using citation-valid rate as a strong factual-faithfulness metric.
issues.recommendation: Move to claim-level attribution with evidence field/window/provenance binding, unit algebra/conversion policy, derivation lineage and separate support/contradiction/insufficiency labels.
